title: AI Adoption Linked to Increased Managerial Roles and Skill Shifts
digest:
A 2026 study by Liudmila Alekseeva et al. found AI adoption in U.S. firms correlates with a 1.2% rise in managerial roles per 1% increase in AI adoption, and a 9% rise in managerial vacancies. The research highlights increased demand for non-routine administrative skills like stakeholder management and sales expertise in AI-intensive companies.

The study challenges the common assumption that AI automates managerial tasks, instead suggesting firms are redefining managerial functions to complement AI systems. It analyzed 12,000 job postings across industries, with data from 2010–2022, focusing on skills not easily automated.

representative.summary: 研究分析了2010年至2022年间美国的职位招聘信息，发现AI采用率每增加1个百分点，管理职位比例增加1.2个百分点，管理职位空缺增加约9%。AI密集型企业更重视非例行行政能力如利益相关者管理、创造力和销售管理等技能。研究未将AI视为自动减少管理者的手段，而是建议重新设计管理职能。
